findings.title: Unclear scope of site preparation
findings.message: The short and long texts do not specify the extent of site preparation (e.g., clearing, leveling, temporary protection). According to VOB/A §7 Abs.1, the description must be unequivocal and exhaustive.
findings.suggestion: Add explicit details: clearing of vegetation, leveling to specified profile, provision of temporary protection for adjacent properties.

findings.title: Missing homogeneity area specification
findings.message: The position lacks the required homogeneity area (Homogenbereich) for the excavation, which is mandatory under VOB/C §4.2.1 and DIN 18300.
findings.suggestion: Specify the homogeneity area and reference geotechnical report.

findings.title: Missing disposal site specification
findings.message: The disposal location and type of landfill are not defined, violating VOB/C §4.2.1.
findings.suggestion: State the approved landfill site and transport route.

findings.title: Missing frost protection material details
findings.message: The type, class, and application method of the frost protection material are omitted, contrary to VOB/C §4.2.1.
findings.suggestion: Specify material (e.g., PE-HD, PE-LD), class, and installation depth.

findings.title: Missing pipe specifications
findings.message: The pipe material, class, and pressure rating are not stated, violating VOB/C §4.2.1.
findings.suggestion: Include PE-HD class (e.g., PE 1000), pressure class, and connection type.

findings.title: Missing formwork details
findings.message: The formwork material, dimensions, and reinforcement are not specified, contrary to VOB/C §4.2.1.
findings.suggestion: State material (e.g., timber, steel), dimensions, and reinforcement details.

findings.title: Missing concrete class and reinforcement details
findings.message: The concrete class (C25/30) is mentioned, but reinforcement type, spacing, and cover are omitted, violating VOB/C §4.2.1.
findings.suggestion: Add reinforcement details (e.g., Ø10 mm, 200 mm spacing, 50 mm cover).

findings.title: Missing concrete compaction details
findings.message: The compaction method and equipment are not described, contrary to VOB/C §4.2.1.
findings.suggestion: Specify compaction method (e.g., vibratory plate, roller) and frequency.

findings.title: Missing formwork specifications
findings.message: The formwork material, dimensions, and support details are omitted, violating VOB/C §4.2.1.
findings.suggestion: Include material, dimensions, and support system.

findings.title: Missing masonry class and reinforcement
findings.message: The masonry class (KS 17,5 cm) is not fully specified; reinforcement and mortar type are missing, violating VOB/C §4.2.1.
findings.suggestion: Add mortar type, reinforcement details, and load class.

findings.title: Missing plastering details
findings.message: The plaster type, number of layers, and curing conditions are omitted, contrary to VOB/C §4.2.1.
findings.suggestion: Specify plaster type (e.g., gypsum), layers, and curing time.

findings.title: Missing cement screed specifications
findings.message: The screed type (CT-C25-F4) lacks details on reinforcement, curing, and finish, violating VOB/C §4.2.1.
findings.suggestion: Add reinforcement, curing regime, and finish specification.

findings.title: Missing insulation thickness and thermal conductivity
findings.message: The insulation thickness and thermal conductivity are not stated, violating VOB/C §4.2.1.

findings.title: Missing waterproofing details
findings.message: The waterproofing material, class, and application method are omitted, contrary to VOB/C §4.2.1.
findings.suggestion: Specify material (e.g., PMBC), water resistance class, and application method.

findings.title: Missing paving details
findings.message: The paving material, joint width, and curing are not specified, violating VOB/C §4.2.1.
findings.suggestion: Add material (e.g., concrete), joint width, and curing time.

findings.title: Missing asphalt layer specifications
findings.message: The asphalt type, compaction method, and thickness are omitted, contrary to VOB/C §4.2.1.
findings.suggestion: Specify asphalt type (e.g., SBS), compaction method, and thickness.

findings.title: Missing asphalt layer specifications
findings.message: The asphalt type, compaction method, and thickness are omitted, contrary to VOB/C §4.2.1.
findings.suggestion: Specify asphalt type (e.g., SBS), compaction method, and thickness.
